IC1: Serious adverse reaction [AND] to any vaccination, as respiratory difficulty, angioedema and anaphylaxis;
IC2: Acute [OR] or chronic disease, as diabetes [OR], heart disease [OR], systemic arterial hypertension;
IC3: Use of anti-allergic [AND] with antigen injections in a maximum timeline of 14 days before the vaccination;
IC4: Use of immunoglobulin in the past 12 months before the study vaccination;
IC5: Use of blood products within 12 months before the vaccination;
IC6: Use of any vaccine type within 30 days before the vaccination of the study;
IC7: Chronic use of any medication, [NOT] except homeopathy, and trivial ones, as nasal physiologic solution [OR] and vitamins;
IC8: Previous immunosuppressive [OR] or cytotoxic medication, in the last 6 months. Individuals who have made use of this kind of medication in non-immunosuppressant doses, as nasal corticosteroid for allergic rhinitis of topic corticosteroid for non-complicated dermatitis, for more than 14 days, are allowed to be included in the study.
IC9: Use of any kind of medication under investigation within one year before the vaccination.
IC10: Unstable asthma or which may have required [OR] urgent care, hospitalization or intubation within the last 2 years [OR], or which requires use of [OR] oral or intravenous corticosteroid.
IC11: Coagulopathies [AND] diagnosed by a physician or report of capillary fragility (ex: bruises [OR] or bleedings without justifiable cause;
IC12: Convulsions, [NOT] except the ones caused by fever, before 2 years old;
IC13: Psychiatric disease which difficults the adherence to the protocol, such as psychosis, obsessive-compulsive disorders, bipolar disease under treatment, diseases which require treatment with lithium and suicidal ideas in the last 5 years from the inclusion;
IC14: Active malignant [OR] (p.e. any kind of cancer) or treated disease, to which the individual may relapse during the study;
IC15: Asplenia ([NOT] absence of spleen [OR] or its removal);
IC16: Positive HIV [OR] in the screening examination of history of any immunosuppressant disease;
IC17: Positive serology for C hepatitis in the screening evaluation;
IC18: Positive Antigen HBs in the screening evaluation;
IC19: Alcoholism (CAGE criteria), used for detection of abusive drinkers or alcoholic, validated in the Brazilian population with sensibility of 88% and specificity of 83%, if two or more answers, among four possible, are afirmative(Mansur and Monteiro, 1983), or according to medical decision;
IC20: Abuse of illicit drugs, according to medical decision;
IC22: Allergy to the vaccine compounds, as egg [OR], neomycin [OR] and gelatin.
